name: New Jersey NJSIAA Meet of Champions Cross Country
headline: Meet of Champions: No. 1 Union Catholic and No. 2 Leah Starkey
summary: No. 1 Union Catholic’s girls, who scored a perfect 15 at last week’s Group meet, go for a fifth straight Meet of Champions title, with No. 19 Ridgewood also in the field. Ocean Township’s Leah Starkey, the No. 2 girl in the country, ran 16:45 at Holmdel last week. In the boys race, Union Catholic and No. 16 CBA meet again a week after Union Catholic beat CBA for the Non-Public A title.
